reason: The text portrays regular people primarily as victims and passive participants in the conflict between God and Pharaoh. The Egyptian populace suffers the plagues without moral characterization; the Israelite people are depicted as oppressed and desperate rather than heroic; Pharaoh's servants, while showing some wisdom in urging release of the Israelites, remain powerless against their ruler. The narrative focuses on divine power and Pharaoh's stubbornness, not on favorable portrayals of ordinary people.
